main_axis.headline: You are pushed forward by managing money and turning opportunities into workable commitments.
main_axis.body: Direct Wealth—steady income built bit by bit—sets the pace; Indirect Wealth—a nose for opportunities and mobilizing resources—adds another source of movement. Direct Resource—systems, credentials, and backing—sits behind them, followed by Seven Killings—external pressure and hard demands—and Direct Officer—rules, positions, and formal standing. This chart does not follow the regular framework; the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions.
main_axis.latent: Direct Resource, Seven Killings, Direct Officer
main_axis.evidence: Direct Wealth weighs 12: 丁 appears as the month stem and is hidden in the year, day, and hour branches 午、戌、午. Indirect Wealth weighs 10: 丙 appears on both the year and hour stems. Direct Resource weighs 4, Seven Killings 3, and Direct Officer 2; 辛 hidden in 酉 and 戌 is Direct Resource, 戊 hidden in 戌 is Seven Killings, and 己 hidden in both 午 branches is Direct Officer. The visible elements are fire 5, earth 1, metal 1, water 1, and wood 0.

core_loop.headline: Managing resources → meeting formal demands → organizing the next round of resources.
core_loop.flow: Direct Wealth—steady income built bit by bit—and Indirect Wealth—a nose for opportunities and mobilizing resources—start the process as you sort resources into planned commitments. Those commitments bring Seven Killings—external pressure and hard demands—and Direct Officer—rules, positions, and formal standing; Direct Resource—systems, credentials, and backing—gives you a way to organize the response and return your attention to managing resources.
core_loop.driver: The day master is labeled as having follow-pattern features; a numerical strength score is not supplied. Direct Wealth weighs 12 and Indirect Wealth 10, while Direct Resource weighs 4, Seven Killings 3, and Direct Officer 2. Visible fire weighs 5, compared with earth 1, metal 1, water 1, and wood 0.
core_loop.leak:
You can spend so much time administering income, opportunities, and formal demands that independent work stays unfinished.
In the ten years starting around age 53 (the 辛卯 pillar), wood runs more strongly in the timing, so self-directed making and speaking have more room.
Right now, set one weekly slot for an independent task and define its finish line before accepting another administrative commitment.
core_loop.evidence: Direct Wealth weighs 12 and Indirect Wealth 10, shown by 丁 on the month stem and 丙 on the year and hour stems, with wealth gods also hidden in 午 and 戌. Seven Killings weighs 3 and Direct Officer 2; 戊 is hidden in 戌 and 己 in both 午 branches. Direct Resource weighs 4, with 辛 hidden in 酉 and 戌. The day master is labeled as having follow-pattern features, and no numerical strength score is supplied. In the age-53 stretch, the pillar is 辛卯; 卯 is a wood branch.

structure_type.name: the income-and-obligations organizer
structure_type.one_line: You turn openings into planned commitments, then use procedures and accumulated know-how to manage them.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when you must assign resources against formal requirements; weakest when you must create a finished piece without a brief or outside demand.
capability_source.text: Your strongest work draws on Direct Wealth—steady income built bit by bit—and Indirect Wealth—a nose for opportunities and mobilizing resources—with formal rules and organized knowledge to work from. When a small team needs a project budget before work begins, you can compare available funds with required costs and assign spending and responsibilities.
capability_source.evidence: Direct Wealth weighs 12 and Indirect Wealth 10; Direct Officer weighs 2 and Direct Resource 4. Visible fire weighs 5, while visible wood weighs 0. Eating God and Hurting Officer each weigh 0.
